# bioexcel/biobb_chemistry/reduce_add_hydrogens

## Summary

This class is a wrapper of the Ambertools reduce module for adding hydrogens to a given structure.

Reduce is a program for adding or removing hydrogens to a Protein DataBank (PDB) molecular structure file.

Nextflow adapter of the [ReduceAddHydrogens](https://biobb-chemistry.readthedocs.io/en/latest/ambertools.html#module-ambertools.reduce_add_hydrogens) building block of [biobb_chemistry](https://github.com/bioexcel/biobb_chemistry) 5.3.0.

## Get started

```nextflow
include { BIOBB_CHEMISTRY_REDUCE_ADD_HYDROGENS } from 'bioexcel/biobb_chemistry/reduce_add_hydrogens'

workflow {
    BIOBB_CHEMISTRY_REDUCE_ADD_HYDROGENS(ch_input)
}
```

Optional input files are passed as `[]`.

## Inputs

| Name | Required | Formats | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `meta` | yes | | Map with at least an `id` key, used as tag and output file prefix |
| `input_path` | yes | pdb | Path to the input file |

## Outputs

Each output channel emits `[meta, file]`. Files are named `<prefix>_<role>.<extension>`, where role is the output argument without `output_` and `_path`.
Optional outputs are only produced if requested in `ext.outputs`.

| Channel | Required | Formats (default first) | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `output_path` | yes | pdb | Path to the output file |
| `versions_biobb_chemistry` | yes | | `[process, 'biobb_chemistry', version]`, also sent to the `versions` topic |

## Configuration

Set with `ext` in a `process` `withName` selector:

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `ext.properties` | Map of ReduceAddHydrogens properties (see below). Defaults: `[can_write_file_log: false]` |
| `ext.outputs` | Map of output argument to extension, for example `[output_path: 'pdb']`. Required outputs use their first format by default; optional outputs are only requested when listed here |
| `ext.prefix` | Output file prefix (default: `meta.id`) |

`raise_error` and `restart` are always set by the adapter: failed commands fail the task, and `-resume` replaces restart.
Do not set the `container_*` properties: Nextflow runs the task inside the biobb_chemistry container.

```groovy
process {
    withName: 'BIOBB_CHEMISTRY_REDUCE_ADD_HYDROGENS' {
        ext.properties = [flip: false]
    }
}
```

### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `flip` | boolean | false | add H and rotate and flip NQH groups |
| `noflip` | boolean | false | add H and rotate groups with no NQH flips |
| `nuclear` | boolean | false | use nuclear X-H distances rather than default electron cloud distances |
| `nooh` | boolean | false | remove hydrogens on OH and SH groups |
| `oh` | boolean | true | add hydrogens on OH and SH groups (default) |
| `his` | boolean | false | create NH hydrogens on HIS rings (usually used with -HIS) |
| `noheth` | boolean | false | do not attempt to add NH proton on Het groups |
| `rotnh3` | boolean | true | allow lysine NH3 to rotate (default) |
| `norotnh3` | boolean | false | do not allow lysine NH3 to rotate |
| `rotexist` | boolean | false | allow existing rotatable groups (OH, SH, Met-CH3) to rotate |
| `rotexoh` | boolean | false | allow existing OH & SH groups to rotate |
| `allalt` | boolean | true | process adjustments for all conformations (default) |
| `onlya` | boolean | false | only adjust 'A' conformations |
| `charges` | boolean | false | output charge state for appropriate hydrogen records |
| `dorotmet` | boolean | false | allow methionine methyl groups to rotate (not recommended) |
| `noadjust` | boolean | false | do not process any rot or flip adjustments |
| `metal_bump` | number | null | H 'bumps' metals at radius plus this |
| `non_metal_bump` | number | null | 'bumps' nonmetal at radius plus this |
| `build` | boolean | false | add H, including His sc NH, then rotate and flip groups (except for pre-existing methionine methyl hydrogens) |
| `binary_path` | string | "reduce" | Path to the reduce executable binary. |
| `remove_tmp` | boolean | true | Remove temporal files. |
| `sandbox_path` | string | "./" | Parent path to the sandbox directory. |
